(async()=>{const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const {switchProject}=await import('/src/studio/assistant/projectSwitch.ts');const {saveFencingJob}=await import('/src/studio/persistence.ts');const {createDefaultJob}=await import('/src/studio/domain.ts');const result=await switchProject(null,{store:useStudio,storage:localStorage,saveJob:(job,options)=>saveFencingJob(job,undefined,options),busy:false,createJobText:()=>JSON.stringify({...createDefaultJob(),name:'AB-01 Courtyard Learning Centre - fixed'})});if(!result.ok)throw Error(JSON.stringify(result));const {useLiveAssistant}=await import('/src/studio/liveAssistantState.ts');useLiveAssistant.setState({open:true});return {project:useStudio.getState().job.id,result};})()
